verdict.rationale: Persona documents linking multiple inquiries to the same underlying Account via a shared reference ID (persona-docs-10) and provides account-level status polling (persona-docs-27), which are building blocks for recognizing a previously verified person across sessions. However, there is no explicit documentation of a mechanism that reuses a prior passed verification result to skip or shortcut a new check — missing for 10: explicit 'reuse prior verification' or 'skip re-verification if already verified' feature, cross-product/tenant reuse guidance, and any workflow example demonstrating a bypass of re-verification based on account history.
